criteria.requirement: Implement tomlkit.editing.apply_edits(document,operations), materializing a finite ordered sequence of set/delete/test records on a detached deep copy. Paths are nonempty sequences of literal string keys and nonnegative integer array indices, never dotted-string parsing. Set may explicitly create missing mapping parents, not arrays; array indices must exist. Test compares unwrapped value and exact Python type before continuing. A late invalid operation, path error or failed test must leave original text and objects unchanged. Preserve unaffected formatting/comments, serialize and reparse final candidate. Do not modify parser internals or promise file-system transactions.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
